finding.issue: The Reviewer transport hard-codes "--mode plan" together with "--disable-slash-commands" and the focused test asserts that combination. This conflicts with the repository's reviewed Antigravity zero-mutation native contract. TASK-126 deliberately removed "--mode plan" from read-only Antigravity invocations after the exact RUN-121-005 failure family produced "warning: --mode plan has no effect while slash command expansion is disabled" and empty stdout; current Antigravity regression coverage explicitly requires read-only commands to contain no "--mode" and no "plan". TASK-191 therefore reintroduces a known contradictory native command shape instead of using the established read-only surface.
